sources.title: Optimization and Tuning - vLLM
sources.snippet: Chunked Prefill ¶ Chunked prefill allows vLLM to process large prefills in smaller chunks and batch them together with decode requests. This feature helps improve both throughput and latency by better balancing compute-bound (prefill) and memory-bound (decode) operations. In V1, chunked prefill is enabled by default whenever possible.
